spike_answers.a_native_oracle: NO. Documented CLI surface (-p/--print, --force, --yolo, --mode, --approve-mcps, --workspace, --resume, mcp, generate-rule, ls, update) has no check/evaluate subcommand. The npm package named cursor-agent is an unrelated third-party package, not the real CLI.
spike_answers.b_documented_semantics: YES, precise enough for honest T2 in ALLOWLIST mode: permission tokens, first-token+glob matching, deny takes precedence over allow. NOT in default Auto-review mode: the classifier is stochastic and staff-confirmed to drop hook 'ask' answers — Auto-review verdicts are unevaluatable and must be labelled so.
spike_answers.c_surface_record: Not applicable; harness is T2 (Allowlist-mode semantics).

measurement_route_evidence: Permission tokens, first-token+glob matching, and deny-precedence are documented precisely enough for evaluation in Allowlist mode; the default Auto-review mode's classifier is stochastic and staff-confirmed to drop hook asks, so it cannot be an oracle.
